title: MediaManifest
description: Output of the Media Agent tracking licensed visual shots retrieved for each scene.

resolution.description: Target width and height in pixels

illustrative_label.description: Whether to display illustrative visuals label on screen

disclose_synthetic_voice.description: Whether AI voice generation disclosure is required

script_origin.description: Provenance of the script driving this media manifest

shot_index.description: Zero-indexed shot sequence number within the scene

start.description: Absolute start time in seconds in the narration audio

end.description: Absolute end time in seconds in the narration audio

card_text.description: Text displayed on graphic card if type is card

file.description: Relative path to local media file, or null if fallback

source.description: Name of the source provider (e.g. user-provided, pixabay, wikimedia)

origin_url.description: Web URL where the media originated, or null

license_url.description: Link to license terms, or null

attribution_text.description: Full formatted attribution string for credits

attribution_required.description: Whether attribution is legally required by license terms

width.description: Pixel width of media asset, or null if fallback

height.description: Pixel height of media asset, or null if fallback

duration_sec.description: Duration in seconds of the shot asset

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the normalized media file, or null if fallback

query.description: Search keyword query used to discover this shot

motion.description: Motion instruction for Motion Agent (e.g. ken_burns for stills)

sensitive_scene.description: Whether this shot is in a sensitive news scene

style.description: Fallback style name if type is fallback

warnings.description: List of warnings generated during media retrieval and normalization
